domains: generic IoT and Web of Things

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic modelling of AI-integrated digital twins for enhanced transparency
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN models individual observations and actuations but not continuous sensing or actuation processes and streams, so new activity classes and a DataStream class are introduced. Reusing sosa:observedProperty, sosa:actsOnProperty, sosa:madeBySensor or sosa:madeByActuator would infer activities as sosa:Observation or sosa:Actuation, so dedicated properties are defined instead. The ssn-system classes are redefined in ADO, the authors believing the Systems module belongs only to an earlier specification. A link from continuous activities to individual observations via EP-PLAN is proposed as future work.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Interoperability and Upgradability Improvement for Context-Aware Systems in Agriculture 4.0
gaps_about_sosa.gap: sosa:Observation does not distinguish measurement, aggregation and deduction, and cannot describe the inputs of an aggregation (addressed with caso:Observation and prov:wasInformedBy); there is no vocabulary for qualitative data or states (caso:State, caso:Boundary added); the use of domainIncludes/rangeIncludes causes OOPS! pitfalls P10, P11 and P13; domain-specific devices, properties, units and actions are not covered; the cbar unit is missing from unit ontologies; the link from deductions to actuator commands is still open

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Web Technologies for Indoor Environmental Quality: A Review and Ontology Design
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN adds owl:allValuesFrom and minCardinality restrictions that are stricter than SOSA's schema:domainIncludes/rangeIncludes. ssn:isPropertyOf is not functional, which conflicts with the intrinsic nature of properties (reported from the AffectedBy ODP). The sensor-specific SOSA pattern was generalised to Executor/Execution (EEP, BOP) to cover static and dynamic properties. No alignment of BOP to SOSA was made, for fear of too-strong ontological commitments. Some extensions (UDSA, WISDOM) use outdated SSN versions.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Self-managed Marketplace for Sharing IoT Sensors
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lack sensor identifiers and support for mobile sensors. The work extends them with sensor ownership (public keys, multi-level ownership), geospatial location, integration concepts (protocol, endpoint, topic, token), cost and payment, and sensor IDs. SSN/SOSA descriptions are rare because of the expertise and cost needed, so the authors plan ML classifiers to generate them. SPARQL queries over SOSA/SSN descriptions are complex, so they plan a simplified query language.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A lightweight sensor ontology for supporting sensor selection, deployment, and data processing in forming processes
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing sensor ontologies, SSN/SOSA included, lack: knowledge for sensor selection; deployment details (interfaces, installation positions, process steps); environmental, installation and safety conditions; and links to data processing methods (signal processing, data preparation, feature extraction). The work extends Condition, Deployment, Platform, OperatingProperty and the observation and sampling collections accordingly.

gaps_about_sosa.title: The KnowWhereGraph ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Census and survey data do not precisely satisfy the SOSA definition of observation but are modelled as observations; sosa:FeatureOfInterest is refined to require a spatial representation; integration relies on spatiotemporal dimensions because observable properties lack harmonising standards; only a kernel of SOSA/SSN is reused; the RDF Data Cube Vocabulary was rejected in favour of SOSA/SSN.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Observation-Metadata-Centric Digital Twin Ontology for Heterogeneous MultiSensor Data in Smart Cities
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN leaves the structure of results open, which makes composite (multi-value) observations and their metadata hard to model consistently; limited direct expression of temporal and spatial context and of continuous values; units need external vocabularies; no strict constraints or metadata grouping rules. The work adds OWL constraints and an STA MultiDatastream-based structure instead.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Domain Ontology for Cooperative Perception in the Internet of Mobile Things
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Unmet requirement: no SOSA/SSN-based pattern for uncertainty or reliability of observations and estimations, addressed by an uncertain result subclass. Modelling difficulty: the functional (=1) cardinality restrictions used in SOSA-like patterns may lead reasoners to infer equality. Also no provenance between estimations and observations, and no probabilistic semantics.

gaps_about_sosa.title: IOTEL: A Tool for Generating IoT-enriched Object-Centric Event Logs
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Full SOSA/SSN judged too complex for event-log integration; a subset is derived with Sensor and Actuator merged into Device, observable and actuatable properties merged into Property, Platform and Deployment merged into Location, and FeatureOfInterest dropped (captured by OCEL objects). Only tabular IoT data are supported; streams and multimodal data are future work.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Représentation sémantique et calcul de formules mathématiques pour l'exploitation de données phénomiques végétales
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Modelling difficulty: in SOSA, observed properties are class instances, not RDF properties, so formula inputs need conditional path navigation that existing approaches do not support. SOSA offers no model for dynamic groups of observations or for aggregations at several granularities, so the thesis proposes Declarative Data Groups (DDGroups) over sosa:Observation.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SmartEnv as a network of ontology patterns
gaps_about_sosa.gap: The first (DUL-based) SSN version causes excessive query processing time. SSN does not cover smart-environment requirements (networks, objects, events, situations, space, time), so extensions are needed. Reusing SSN/DUL vocabularies was not straightforward and finding suitable generic concepts was time-consuming; tooling to support vocabulary reuse is requested.

gaps_about_sosa.title: The KnowWhereGraph Ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA's definition of Observation (made by a sensor) does not strictly fit census and survey data, which are nevertheless modelled as observations. sosa:FeatureOfInterest is refined to require a spatial representation. Observable properties lack standards for harmonisation, so integration relies on space and time. Only a kernel of SOSA/SSN is reused.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Maritime Linked Data for Situational Awareness Heterogeneous Sensor Networks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA does not let sensors and observations be observed as features of interest, which quality assessment needs, so MSA-HSN subclasses them under sosa:FeatureOfInterest. The authors prefer OM (scales) to QUDT. sosa:Result is extended for qualitative, categorical, multi-granular spatio-temporal values and uncertainty. IoT-Stream is used for streams.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Digital Twin-Based Zero-Touch Management for IoT
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN focuses on observations; it describes devices only through the Sensor class and lacks device attributes (identifier, manufacturer, firmware, owner, access list, protocol, location) and the device's purpose of use or tasks. The authors propose a separate device ontology claimed to be compatible with SSN (unmet requirement / extension proposed).

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Ontology for Human-Robot Collaboration
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN's scope is limited to observable properties and sensing devices and misses HRC needs (tasks, capabilities, humans as agents, intentions). The classification of ObservableProperty as a subclass of DUL:Property is too rigid; the authors propose modelling observability as a DUL:Role (ObservableFeature) that depends on the deployed sensors.

gaps_about_sosa.title: PROV ontology supports alignment of observational data (models)
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Criticism of the original SSN alignment to DOLCE-Ultralite, which prevented ssn:Observation being an activity or event (resolved in SOSA/SSN 2017). The proposed PROV/OBOE/BCO alignments are provisional and incomplete. Further property alignments need elaborate restrictions and property chains, and consistency remains to be verified.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Global IoT Device Discovery and Integration Vision
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks metadata for device provider/ownership, usage cost and payment, device location, unique identification of identical devices, access permission, wrapper URI and integrity hash; the authors propose ad hoc SSN extensions (ID, Geo, Org/Prsn Owner, Permission, URI, Hash tags) for discovery, integration, payment and security.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic BMS: Allowing usage of building automation data in facility benchmarking
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN alone lacks the data point concept and domain-specific restrictions (ssn:Property has no properties or restrictions) so SSN was extended; modelling bottleneck: data point types modelled as classes make some queries expensive; zones not modelled; measurements not represented in RDF; future work on alignment with ifcOWL/BOT.

gaps_about_sosa.title: On Modeling the Physical World as a Collection of Things: The W3C Thing Description Ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: The alignment favours simplicity over completeness. Distinguishing command types (on/off) is not solvable with SSN and needs SAREF. Informational properties (version number, label) do not fit ssn:Property. Inference of SSN statements from @type tags is fragile. Tooling to detect semantic inconsistencies is lacking.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Knowledge Graph Construction for Seismic Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lacks properties linking observed waveforms to seismic intensity (JMA scale) and to the hypocenter, so new properties were created; SSN/SOSA cannot represent the multilayer structure of earthquakes (fault slip, hypocenter, waveforms), which makes it hard to handle observed and estimated results together.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Survey of Techniques for Discovering, Using, and Paying for Third-Party IoT Sensors
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is judged not comprehensive: it does not cover device ownership, location, the measurement format of IoT data, or the information needed for integration and payment (payment ID, cost of use, URI, integration protocol, access token); an SSN-based ontology for payment and integration is cited as early work.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Integration eines digitalen Maschinenparks in ein Forschungsdatenmanagementsystem
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN classes (ssn:System, sosa:Sensor, sosa:Actuator) are too abstract, and the System Capability module does not suit concrete equipment types characterised by manufacturer, model and location. SOSA/SSN was therefore not reused in MATO, only judged usable for mapping with upper ontologies such as BFO.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Bridging Model for Process Mining and IoT
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/IoTStream are event-centric and pay little attention to devices and platforms; SSN seen as aiming at completeness rather than simplicity; the IoT event, context event and process event concepts needed for process mining are not covered and are added in a UML model, with an OWL implementation planned.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Extending the IoT-Stream Model with a Taxonomy for Sensors in Sustainable Smart Cities
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Unmet requirement: SOSA/SSN (and IoT-Lite, IoT-Stream) give no clear identification of the sensor type or underlying technology (reliability, precision, accuracy), which motivates a taxonomic sensor ID. SOSA also has no explicit geometry properties and delegates them to ontologies such as GeoSPARQL.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Cyber twins supporting industry 4.0 application development
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN describes hardware (sensors, actuators, platform) but lacks the software elements of a machine (operating system, application, machine settings) and the composition of complex machines with control loops; extension proposed with ct:IoTDevice, ct:Application and ct:OperatingSystem.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Advancements towards Global IoT Device Discovery and Integration
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks metadata for device provider/ownership, cost and payment, location (geo coordinates, mobile devices), unique identification of identical devices, permissions and authentication (hash); the authors add ID, Geo, URI, Permission, Org/Prsn Owner and Hash tags as SSN extensions.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantics in the Edge: Sensors and actuators in the Web of Linked Data and Things
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN System modelling issues (reconfiguration capabilities, S3N extension); property/feature-of-interest axiomatization leading to interoperability issues; convergence of SOSA/SSN, SAREF and other initiatives; domain ontologies such as M3Lite still need to be adapted to the new SSN

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Ontology-Driven Ambient Assisted Living Framework for Personalized Elderly Care with Health-Risk Inference
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA is domain-agnostic and does not model elderly-specific health risks, clinical risk semantics or recommendations (unmet requirement); remote SOSA imports were disabled and a local madeBySensor property was used to avoid dependency overhead during benchmarking (tooling).

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Unified Management Framework for EIoT Systems Based on Metadata and Event Detection
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN and other IoT ontologies cannot be applied directly to the unified management of multiple heterogeneous EIoT systems; SOSA has to be combined with FIEMSER (network protocols), QUDT (units), WGS84 (location), OWL-Time (time) and a custom DataSource ontology (storage access).

gaps_about_sosa.title: OD4CoT: um dataset baseado em ontologia para o Contexto das Coisas
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN and its extensions provide only terminology, not a dataset of smart-object instances and their contexts; the authors did not extend SSN, to keep their scope restricted, reused only the SSN units module (qu:unit), and plan to incorporate existing ontologies later

gaps_about_sosa.title: Using LOT methodology to develop a noise pollution ontology: a Spanish use case
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN-XG lacks a link from ssn:ObservationValue to a unit of measure, so a new property was defined; OOPS! pitfalls come from the reused SSN-XG and its DOLCE Ultralite dependency; migration to SOSA/SSN 2017 planned to make the ontology lighter and remove the pitfalls.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Systematic design of health monitoring systems centered on older adults and ADLs
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA and other IoT models lack concepts for ADLs (basic/instrumental/advanced), health status and multi-dimensional health; the authors combine them with IoT-Lite, IoT-Stream, FOAF, QU and ICF and add sensor subclasses (physiological, environmental).

gaps_about_sosa.title: WoTDL: Web of Things Description Language for Automatic Composition
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN does not model a state-transition system from an initial to a goal state, the preconditions and effects of actuations on the environment, or how to invoke a WoT device over HTTP; durations (time to effect, wait after actuation) are added on Actuation

gaps_about_sosa.title: CPSWatch: Lightweight Ontology for System Description and Diagnosis
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN do not differentiate sensor types by operational data handling (event-driven, continuous, status); the full sosa:Observation/sosa:Sensor classes are avoided to keep the ontology lightweight; future mapping from SOSA data to CPSWatch is planned.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Smart Data for Goods and Vehicle Monitoring – Practical Considerations on Data Semantization
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA lacked domain concepts (beacons, carriers, restrictions); the SOSA/SSN-based model with RDFS/OWL inference was too slow for real-time ingestion and was abandoned for a simplified custom vocabulary, with SOSA to be reintegrated later if needed.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Development of an Ontology-Based Framework to Enhance Geospatial Data Discovery and Selection in Geoportals for Natural-Hazard Early Warning Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA used to add observation context missing from DCAT; SOSA FeatureOfInterest/ObservableProperty are instance-level, so separate metadata-level thematic classes (FeatureTheme, PropertyTheme as skos:Concept) were defined for dataset classification.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Interoperable Information Flow as Enabler for Efficient Predictive Maintenance
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Tooling: AI tools do not accept ontologies as input and a triple store does not suit large near real-time data, so SOSA-annotated data are converted to a custom JSON schema; future work on domain ontologies for data types other than time series.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Erweiterung der künstlichen DNA um eine semantische Beschreibungsebene
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA focuses on observation data and treats sensors and systems as a monolithic block; it lacks a fine-grained description of system components and of the physical relationships between sensed quantities, so the author built an own ontology.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic-based anomaly detection in laboratory environments using SOSA/SSN sensor ontology frameworks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN is application-independent and must be extended with domain classes and properties. Prior works used it with few platforms and sensors. Future work: further enrichment, a web interface, and machine learning on the semantic sensor data.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An event logic graph for geographic environment observation planning in disaster chain monitoring
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN are judged static: they describe sensors and the generation of observation data, but they cannot express the motivation of observations, event logic or observation planning, and suit only single-disaster scenarios (unmet requirement).

gaps_about_sosa.title: Modeling Inhabited Smart Spaces to Support Interoperable IoT-Based Applications
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Sensor ontologies such as SSN/SOSA and SAREF lack vocabulary connecting inhabitants, activities and fine-grained spatial topology to the sensor infrastructure, and do not model uncertain, sensor-derived locations; INHAB extends them for this.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Spatio-Temporal Semantic Data Model for Precision Agriculture IoT Networks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN-based models (e.g. AIM) are criticised as having a complex syntax (RDF, JSON-LD, Turtle) unsuitable for real-time management and for data generation by resource-constrained IoT devices; a lightweight JSON model is proposed instead.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Crossing the chasm between ontology engineering and application development: A survey
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN is too complex for simple applications, with a verbose time-interval representation (sosa:phenomenonTime, time:Interval, time:Instant). The authors suggest automatically translating heavyweight ontologies into lightweight versions.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Smart Interconnected Infrastructure for Security and Safety in Public Places
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN has a single class for all sensors, which makes it hard to annotate sensor-specific parameters; existing ontologies annotate little of the time-space correlation of sensor data; event and public-security concepts need new ontologies.

gaps_about_sosa.title: FIDES: An ontology-based approach for making machine learning systems accountable
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Criticism of the axiomatisation: SOSA/SSN admits different models for the same state of affairs, which may cause interoperability problems; it was discarded in favour of the EEPSA ODPs (AffectedBy, EEP, RC), which have stronger axioms.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Smart Environmental Data Infrastructures: Bridging the Gap between Earth Sciences and Citizens
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No complete environmental observation and modeling ontology exists. SSN lacks support for model metadata and for efficient storage generation. The paper proposes aligning with or extending SSN and combining it with GeoDCAT-AP.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Observational Process Ontology-Based Modeling Approach for Water Quality Monitoring
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks a detailed description of the observational process (processing methods, processed observation products) and of domain-specific water quality monitoring and pollution alerting, although it has richer sensor metadata.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Review of Neuro-Symbolic AI for Smart Cities: Architectures, Ontologies, and IoT-Driven Applications
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Semantic drift: static SSN/SOSA implementations cannot accommodate new sensors with proprietary data formats; despite SSN/SOSA and SAREF, departments build conflicting custom ontologies, which hinders cross-domain reasoning.

gaps_about_sosa.title: From Opaque Streams to Explainable Systems: Semantic MQTT Integration at the Edge
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN does not model the transport of observation streams, M2M protocols such as MQTT, message framing, heterogeneous payload formats or character encodings; the work proposes an aligned MQTT ontology to fill this gap.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Immersive analytics with augmented reality in meteorology: an exploratory study on ontology and linked data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks classes for complex meteorological phenomena (storm, hurricane, depression); existing ontologies are oversized or have too many dependencies for real-time AR querying, so a lighter SSN-based ontology is proposed

gaps_about_sosa.title: ADISTES Ontology for Active Diagnosis of Sensors and Actuators in Distributed Embedded Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks Symptom and Fault classes needed for active diagnosis; the work adds Symptom, Fault and Location classes and repurposes Sampling/FeatureOfInterest to store observation windows and sensor limits/faulty patterns.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Description of Quality of Data in Sensor Networks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: extension proposed: SSN lacks a description of quality of data (indicators, metrics, interpretations), added through a subclass of SystemProperty; future work: events and quality of data of soft and model-based sensors

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Modeling of Trustworthy IoT Entities in Energy-Efficient Cultural Spaces
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA/SSN-specific gap is reported. The stated limitations are that trustworthiness of IoT entities is not adequately demonstrated, and future work will add classes and properties linked to SOSA, CrossCult and SAREF.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Critical infrastructure awareness based on IoT context data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing ontologies, SOSA/SSN-based ones included, lack joint coverage of sensing, actuation and context-aware rules, and lack gateway modelling. TOCA extends SOSA (Platform for Gateway and Group) to fill these needs.

gaps_about_sosa.title: WeKG-MF: A Knowledge Graph of Observational Weather Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Extension proposed: domain classes restricting observations to one weather property and one feature; units attached to properties and reusable OWL-Time interval classes to avoid redundancy. No criticism of SOSA/SSN.

gaps_about_sosa.title: The Role of Semantic Technologies in Diagnostic and Decision Support for Service Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN judged too expressive for a lightweight OWL 2 EL platform; SOSA judged too simple; a new ontology is needed for sensor reliability, system states, operating and scale ranges, failure modes and mitigation actions

gaps_about_sosa.title: Using Ontologies to Create Machine-Actionable Datasets: Two Case Studies
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No direct way to represent measurement uncertainty (a workaround with an SSN system property was used); too much freedom in modelling with SSN/PROV-O, so good practices are needed; metrological concepts are lacking.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A semantic mechanism for Internet-of-Things (IoT) to implement intelligent interactions
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is generic and lacks specific components for practical use cases. The SSN-based ontologies reviewed (IoT-Lite, IoT-O, SHO) do not support users' personalized preferences or reasoning for device decision making.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Systems Engineering-based semantic model to support “Product-Service System” life cycle
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN(-XG) is judged mostly technical; it had to be tailored and extended to link sensors with service characteristics, maintenance activities, machine components, mounting and working conditions for industrial PSS.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A novel ontology consistent with acknowledged standards in smart homes
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks spatial and temporal information about sensors and sensor data (only a placeholder in ssn:Observation) and ignores user profiles; extensions proposed for spatiotemporal annotation and user profiles.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Industrial IoT-Based Ontology Development for Well-Being, Aging and Health: A Scoping Review
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Shortcomings of SSN reported: real-time data collection, no taxonomy for measurement units, context and quantity kinds, exposing sensors to services; SSN/SOSA centred on devices and not covering data streams.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Connected Traffic Data Ontology (CTDO) for Intelligent Urban Traffic Systems Focused on Connected (Semi) Autonomous Vehicles
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA observation is per sensor, which is inefficient for bulk vehicle state messages; the work removes restrictions on observation to allow multi-sensor observations; RDF tool scalability is also a limitation

gaps_about_sosa.title: COVID-Forecast-Graph: An Open Knowledge Graph for Consolidating COVID-19 Forecasts and Economic Indicators via Place and Time
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA has no means for forecast uncertainty (quantile distributions), so subproperties of sosa:hasSimpleResult were added; forecasts are modelled as observations whose phenomenonTime is later than resultTime.

gaps_about_sosa.title: QoC enhanced semantic IoT model
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN limited to sensors rather than objects in general; lack of quality of context (QoC) meta-data in SSN-based IoT models, addressed by adding QoC criteria (accuracy, precision, freshness, trustworthiness…)

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Systematic Comparison and Evaluation of Building Ontologies for Deploying Data-Driven Analytics in Smart Buildings
gaps_about_sosa.gap: The four building ontologies are missing or only partially have the observation–property and feature-of-interest–property links of SSN/SOSA. The work recommends reusing SSN/SOSA for sensors and actuators.

gaps_about_sosa.title: WMO: an ontology for the semantic enrichment of wetland monitoring data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA lacks units of measure and domain knowledge linked to observed properties, so QUDT units are added; the semantics of phenomenon and result time are extended with valid and transaction time classes.

gaps_about_sosa.title: WoR Ontology: Modeling Resources in Web Connected Environments
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA cover only the physical aspect of IoT and lack descriptions of services/interfaces, composed and virtual services, service links and QoS; SSN is considered too heavy for dynamic environments.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Enrichment of IoT Stream Data On-demand
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Semantic descriptions of IoT data (e.g. with SSN) do not address the volume and velocity of stream data; the work proposes on-demand semantification and factorization instead of an ontology extension.

gaps_about_sosa.title: ISEE : un système pour l'explication des événements dans les environnements hybrides - mise en œuvre sur des données de capteurs associées à des corpus documentaires
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks precise description of deployment environments, sensor mobility, multimedia data, sensor metadata such as range and accuracy, and events; SOSA/SSN lacks detailed platform types and mobility

gaps_about_sosa.title: OntoDomus: A Semantic Model for Ambient Assisted Living System Based on Smart Homes
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN, designed for meteorological needs, had to be extended to home automation, ubiquitous systems and the description of a person's tasks as measurable data (smart, effecting and controller devices).

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Ontology-Based Framework for Integrating Remote Sensing Imagery, Image Products, and In Situ Observations
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks concepts for remote sensing imagery and image products; satellites are only platforms. The work extends SOSA/SSN with image result classes, spatial pixels, bands and characteristic indices.

gaps_about_sosa.title: BSOA: A Battery Specification-Observation-Anomaly Ontology for Explaining Battery Anomaly Detection
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Extension proposed: modality-agnostic image observation hierarchy, image result classes with detected regions, and temporal/spatial cross-modal links between observations; no criticism of SOSA/SSN.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Collaborative Network for District Energy Operation and Semantic Technologies: A Case Study
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN does not include locations, units or sensor hierarchy types (must be added via other ontologies); SSN is abstract compared with industry-oriented SAREF, with semantic overlaps between the two.

gaps_about_sosa.title: IoTO++: An Enhanced Interoperability Based on Semantic for IoT Environments
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing IoT ontologies, SOSA/SSN included, lack privacy, security, energy-awareness and ethics modelling; IoTO++ adds these modules. SSN-SOSA has low relationship richness in the OQuaRE metrics.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic-based privacy settings negotiation and management
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No requirement, extension need or criticism concerning SOSA/SSN is reported; the limitations are those of PPIoT (no temporal modelling of preference changes, no control over data once disclosed).

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Reproducible Benchmark-Validity Audit and Calibration Study for Cross-Home Fault Diagnosis in Smart-Home Sensor Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing ontologies, SSN/SOSA included, lack abnormality-pattern classes and diagnostic causal relations. The authors extend them with abnormality-pattern classes and four causal relation types.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Making heterogeneous smart home data interoperable with the SAREF ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is seen as too narrowly sensor-focused and too rigid, excluding devices such as locks and lights; SOSA is lighter. Smart sensors that select algorithms need an extension (S3N, Sagar et al.).

gaps_about_sosa.title: IoT Device Integration and Payment via an Autonomic Blockchain-Based Service for IoT Device Sharing
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Extension proposed: SSN extended with device/provider identifiers, location, permission, payment, integration endpoint, measurement templates, payment transactions and data access notifications.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Problem Detection in the Edge of IoT Applications.
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN (and SAREF) do not cover integration of cloud, edge computing and IoT device information (software deployment, topology, problems); a new ontology ECO based on SEAS is proposed instead.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ubiquitous IoT Sensor Sharing via an Open Self-Manged Marketplace
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lack sensor identification and mobile sensor support; the cost and expertise needed to write SSN descriptions is a barrier, so ML classifiers are proposed to generate them automatically

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Context-Aware Knowledge Graph Platform for Stream Processing in Industrial IoT
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA/SSN-specific gap reported; existing semantic IoT models focus on annotating streams without supporting stream processing, motivating separate stream-gathering and transformation modules.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Observations Framework for data interoperability: Enabling descriptive regional data for soil and land management in the Australian context
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Missing machine-actionable vocabularies for soil samples and sampling; contextual information could be delivered with the SSN actuator component; metadata on quality and provenance not covered.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Ontology-based Metamodel for Capability Descriptions
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN focuses on systems and sensors and is only remotely related to capability matching; direct import adds overhead, so a separate mapping ontology (C4I2SSN) is used instead of importing SSN.

gaps_about_sosa.title: KnowWhereGraph-Lite: A Perspective of the KnowWhereGraph
gaps_about_sosa.gap: The rich SOSA/SSN observation structure makes queries multi-hop and hard for non-experts. The work collapses the kernel into shortcut predicates that combine the property and the result time.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Data Ontology Assessment To Support Smart And Ongoing Commissioning Of Buildings
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is generic, not building-specific: there is no functionality to map SSN data to BIM/IFC, custom SSN tag extensions and a mapping schema are needed, so SSN is judged not optimal for SOCx.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Metadata schema for virtual sensors in digital twin-enabled building systems using Brick schema
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lacks mechanisms to represent simulation- or inference-based (virtual) sensors and their modelling metadata; no mapping between the proposed Brick extension and SSN/SOSA exists yet.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SAREF4health: Towards IoT standard-based ontology-driven cardiac e-health systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lacks a compact time-series representation: each measurement must be an Observation with its own properties, which makes messages too verbose for real-time high-frequency ECG data.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SigSPARQL: Signals as a First-Class Citizen when Querying Knowledge Graphs1
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA/SSN-specific gap. General criticism of observation-based sensor data models: computations over asynchronous time series and integration are cumbersome; signals are proposed instead.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Towards a semantic model for IoT-based seismic event detection and classification
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA classes extended with domain-specific properties (unit, signal type, observation frequency) and structures for multi-component waveform data frames and arrays; no explicit criticism

gaps_about_sosa.title: Enhancing polymer electrolyte membrane fuel cell system diagnostics through semantic modelling
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN too expressive (2NExpTime-complete) for a lightweight on-line platform; SOSA too simple to capture fuel cell monitoring knowledge, hence a new OWL 2 EL ontology reusing SOSA concepts

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Matchmaking & Mediation for Sensors on the Sensor Web
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SSN-specific gap. The approach needs similarity-based ranking, depends on secondary ontologies for units and observed properties, and its set of sensor attribute types is incomplete.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SOSA-SHACL: Shapes Constraint for the Sensor, Observation, Sample, and Actuator Ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA lacks real constraints (open world); the exactly-one sensor constraint is too strong; the range of hasSimpleResult is undefined; phenomenonTime/resultTime constraints are missing

gaps_about_sosa.title: Context-aware IoT search engine through fuzzy clustering: Search space restructuring and query resolution mechanisms
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN extended with sensor context properties (accuracy, frequency, delay, response time, bandwidth, reliability, measurement range) needed for context-aware search; no criticism of SSN

gaps_about_sosa.title: Investigation design: The structural elements of knowledge-seeking efforts
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No criticism of SSN itself; the paper states that existing sensor and observation models lack a common design pattern covering all elements of an investigation (initiative, judgment).

gaps_about_sosa.title: Food process ontology requirements
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Gap analysis of OBO against SOSA: OBO lacks sensor, actuator and sampler classes and an actuation process; SOSA's specific relations are compared with OBO's minimal property approach.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Internet of Things: A comprehensive survey on syntactic and semantic interoperability for effective inter-entity communication
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN-based platforms such as OpenIoT cannot integrate solutions that use other ontologies; manual alignment between SSN, SOSA and other ontologies is costly and lacks public datasets.

gaps_about_sosa.title: MSSN-Onto: An ontology-based approach for flexible event processing in Multimedia Sensor Networks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN targets only scalar sensors and has no concepts for multimedia sensors and multimedia data; the work proposes extensions of sosa:Sensor and sosa:Result (extension proposed).

gaps_about_sosa.title: Towards Semantic Sensor Data: An Ontology Approach
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Sensor ontologies built on SSN/SOSA define the same concepts non-uniformly across application fields, which makes them hard to share and reuse; ontology mapping is proposed instead.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ontology Interoperability: A Comprehensive Framework for Industrial-Scale Applications
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA and SSN do not capture the sensor stimulus or the actual feature of interest (sample); the old and new SSN are not aligned neatly, which required design choices between terms

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic framework of event detection in emergency situations for smart buildings
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN has no concepts for multimedia sensor network infrastructure and data, and no atomic or complex event modelling; mobile sensors and coordinate observations needed extensions.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SOSA: A Lightweight Ontology for Sensors, Observations, Samples, and Actuators
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA has no ultimate agent, geometry or collections classes; custom datatypes for units are not supported by RDF/SPARQL engines; actuation procedure interfaces are out of scope

gaps_about_sosa.title: ORKA: An Ontology for Robotic Knowledge Acquisition
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lack details on robot-specific sensors and perception algorithms, and on the characteristics of the environment; extra properties such as sampling rate had to be added

gaps_about_sosa.title: Weather data standards: a gap exploration report
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Low awareness and uptake of semantic and Linked Data standards (including SSN/SOSA) in the meteorological community; low perceived demand; tooling lacking for semantic formats.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Towards semantic enrichment of Earth Observation data: The LEODS framework
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN considered too complex for simple sensor descriptions; fine-grained SSN observation descriptions judged unnecessary for non-expert stakeholders of aggregated EO data.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Design and Implementation of a Malfunction Detection System for Livestock Ventilation Devices in Smart Poultry Farms
gaps_about_sosa.gap: The full SSN ontology is judged too complex and inefficient for real-world applications; the authors fall back on the stimulus-sensor-observation pattern and related patterns.

gaps_about_sosa.title: The UDSA ontology: An ontology to support real time urban sustainability assessment
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Update to the new SSN version needed; one ssn:Observation per timestamp makes time series too voluminous for reasoning (workaround: ONTOP, OWL 2 QL, reduced expressiveness).

gaps_about_sosa.title: Using ANPR data to create an anonymized linked open dataset on urban bustle
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks domain-specific properties for location, time and what is observed; these are filled with other vocabularies (CoT observable properties, OWL-Time, Core Location).

gaps_about_sosa.title: The Curse of Sensing: Survey of techniques and challenges to cope with sparse and dense data in mobile crowd sensing for Internet of Things
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is not expressive enough to support mobility concepts in mobile crowdsensing (unmet requirement); no global data structure for mobile device capabilities and equipment.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Serverless GEO Labels for the Semantic Sensor Web
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Mapping limited by few realistic SSN datasets; the RDF/XML document-based approach does not exploit reasoning; GEO label facets may not address dynamic SSW discovery needs.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Information in Sensor Networks: How to Combine Existing Ontologies, Vocabularies and Data Schemes to Fit a Metrology Use Case
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No single ontology covers all metrological requirements: uncertainty, calibration models and units need combining with OM, D-SI and MathML; SSN-System may need adaptation.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Model for Meteorological Knowledge Graphs: Application to Météo-France Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN only supports single atomic observations, with no aggregation (solved with RDF Data Cube); observable properties and features of interest are left to communities

gaps_about_sosa.title: FFO: Forest Fire Ontology and Reasoning System for Enhanced Alert and Management Services
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is domain-independent and had to be extended with forest-fire sensor types, observation subclasses, risk levels and linking properties; GeoSPARQL added for locations.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Applications of Ontology in the Internet of Things: A Systematic Analysis
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN has vague concepts for relating sensors to other things in IoT infrastructure; it uses a single concept for sensor description and cannot model an entire IoT system.

gaps_about_sosa.title: 4W1H in IoT Semantics
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing ontologies, including SSN-based ones, lack core concepts such as access control; heterogeneity of unified ontologies persists; no standard base ontology exists.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Linked Data Architecture for Assistance and Traceability in Smart Manufacturing
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No formal alignment with SOSA/SSN yet; RDF has no native support for storing temporal data at high sample rates, so SOSA observations need time series database storage.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Building Blocks: Sensing, Actuating, and Communicating
gaps_about_sosa.gap: IoT ontologies, SSN included, focus on formal models and reasoning and neglect API-level interoperability; the authors prefer an asset-centric approach such as SensorML

gaps_about_sosa.title: Internet of Things
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN (SSN-XG) was designed before the mainstream adoption of the IoT and lacks IoT concepts such as Thing, Actuator and Actuation; IoT-O and then SOSA address this gap.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Overview of Semantic Interoperability Ontologies and Frameworks for IoT
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN criticised: no features of interest, units or domain knowledge modelling; limited to sensor networks; weak reasoning; needs enhancement for IoT; manual annotation

gaps_about_sosa.title: Event Representation and Research on Formalizing Representation Model Based on Ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks non-categorical event relationships (temporal sequence, causality, composition); the authors add collection membership and align SSN with an event ontology

gaps_about_sosa.title: Fuzzy-Based Fine-Grained Human Activity Recognition within Smart Environments
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Crisp OWL/DL ontologies (including the SSN-based model) cannot express imprecise sensor measurements; fuzzy ontology added to handle this. No SSN-specific criticism.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ontology and Rules for Characterization of Sensors and Actuators Devices in AADL Models
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN does not cover system architecture components (software, hardware, interfaces, connections); the authors propose extensions toward the architecture domain

gaps_about_sosa.title: Enhancing awareness of industrial robots in collaborative manufacturing
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN (with CORA) is insufficient to describe production procedures and human-robot collaborations; observability is modelled through a DUL:Role (ObservableFeature).

gaps_about_sosa.title: A survey of semantic web technology for agriculture
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN seen as used for sensor and property discovery rather than for describing transmitted sensor data; competing sensor ontologies exist despite standardisation.

gaps_about_sosa.title: The Ontologically based Model for the Integration of the IoT and Cloud ERP Services
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Unmet requirement and extension proposed: SSN/SOSA do not cover Cloud ERP API functionalities, inputs and outputs; the authors plan to extend them (future work).

gaps_about_sosa.title: A semantic framework for condition monitoring in Industry 4.0 based on evolving knowledge bases
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN properties lack domains and ranges (OOPS! pitfall); the authors added them in COInd4. Alignment with top-level ontologies such as DUL is left as future work.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Automatic Knowledge Extraction to Build Semantic Web of Things Applications
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lacks a standardized taxonomy of observable properties, controlled vocabularies of features of interest, sensor/actuator types, and industry procedures

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Semantic Digital Twin-Driven Framework for Multi-Source Data Integration in Forest Fire Prediction and Response
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA/SSN-specific gap reported; framework limitations: no real-time stream processing, scalability of reasoning, and dependence on expert knowledge in rules

gaps_about_sosa.title: Modeling Industrial IoT Security Using Ontologies: A Systematic Review
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks security concepts; the text proposes extending ssn Sensor/System with CVO attributes (Threat, Impact, Attack Complexity) for IIoT security modelling.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic models for IoT sensing to infer environment–wellness relationships
gaps_about_sosa.gap: custom datatypes in SOSA lack recognised IRIs; QUDT and OM raise OWL2 import errors; scalability of per-observation links requires collections of observations

gaps_about_sosa.title: Introduction of Guidelines for Maintaining Personal Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing W3C ontologies (incl. SOSA) focus on primary-use metadata; new classes/properties (e.g., sensor detail, synchronization) are added for secondary use.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic and Dweller-Based Decision Support System for the Reconfiguration of Domestic Environments: RecAAL
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN judged too detailed for the scope of the DSS and not reused; an alignment of recAAL:Sensor with SOSA (including sosa:Actuator) is proposed as future work

gaps_about_sosa.title: Models for Internet of Things Environments - A Survey
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Ontology-based models such as SSN are heavyweight for resource-constrained devices; SSN location depends on DUL; otherwise SSN judged to fulfil all criteria.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Towards a secure data sharing management approach for IoT environments
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN's single-result observation constraint lacks expressivity for sequences, so an ObservationCollection is proposed; data quality metadata is still lacking.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Privacy management in connected environments
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN lacks representation of sensor mobility, multimedia information diversity and uncertainty; these are added via HSSN and the W3C Uncertainty ontology

gaps_about_sosa.title: Building Semantic-Based Applications in IoT Environments With IoTO++
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA/SSN-specific gap; general limitations: complexity of merging several ontologies, no domain-specific concepts (room, visitor), reasoning scalability.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Web Technologies in Sensor-Based Personal Health Monitoring Systems: A Systematic Mapping Study
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Low uptake of SOSA/SSN in health monitoring systems, which limits the expressiveness of sensor descriptions and the querying and reasoning over sensor data.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Toward Semantic Event-Handling for Building Explainable Cyber-Physical Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Extension proposed: SOSA extended (SENSE) to represent events as observation results, their causal relations and detection procedures; no criticism of SOSA.

gaps_about_sosa.title: La Búsqueda de Interacción Semántica en la Web de las Cosas: Una Revisión
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Gaps are general: no unified contextual semantics, missing formal semantic models, risk of proliferation of incorrect ontologies; none specific to SOSA/SSN

gaps_about_sosa.title: The evolution of a geoscience standard: An instructive tale of science keyword development and adoption
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Low adoption of SSN/SOSA in archives; mismatch with engineered systems; SOSA too abstract for discovery systems; archive managers struggle with ontologies

gaps_about_sosa.title: Modelling sensor ontology with the SOSA/SSN frameworks: a case study for laboratory parameters
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Units for simple results are handled by a custom MeasurementUnit class and hasMeasurementUnit property; no other gap or criticism of SOSA/SSN is reported.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Cyberlogic: A Foundational Framework for Cross-Space Logic in the Cyber-Physical-Social-Thinking Hyperspace
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Semantic alignment with SSN/SOSA does not address coordination of different reasoning paradigms, combining confidence levels, or resolving contradictions.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Observational/hydrographic data of the South Atlantic Ocean published as LOD
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN could model human census observations, but Darwin Core/BiGe-Onto was preferred for species occurrences to match biodiversity community standards.

gaps_about_sosa.title: NICE-Food KG: A knowledge graph for the analysis of the Nutritional, Ingredient, Contaminant, and Environmental characteristics of food for food system research
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA/SSN-specific gap. In general, existing ontologies lack contextual details (packaging, processing, preparation), and ontology expansion is needed.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Preliminary Study of semantic Virtual Geographic Environment in the Context of Wetland Monitoring
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA does not define units/measurement information for results; QUDT reused to add units. OWL-Time lacks periodic time collections, extended by the work.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Knowledge-Based Sequential Sensor Selection Approach for Fast Object Classification
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No prior use of SOSA with a domain ontology for incremental classification minimising the cost of sensors; no limitation of SOSA/SSN itself is reported.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Metaization concepts for monitoring-related information
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Limitations of SSN: measurement units, locations, time series; combine with other ontologies; SHM characteristics not covered by the reviewed languages

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ruleless Digital Twins: Toward Declarative Decision-Making Through Standardized Frameworks and Technologies
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks concepts for user specifications, effects and actions, so extensions were needed; a comparison of SAREF and SOSA/SSN per domain is called for

gaps_about_sosa.title: Model-Driven Engineering of Monitoring Application for Sensors and Actuators Networks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA is too generic and coarse-grained and does not specify processes; SSN lacks measurands and a reusable definition of sensors and actuators by model

gaps_about_sosa.title: A semantic data model for sensory spatio-temporal environmental concepts
gaps_about_sosa.gap: RDF/SSN-style models do not natively represent spatio-temporal environmental concepts; the work proposes a conceptual model of location and time layers

gaps_about_sosa.title: IoT Data Processing for Smart City and Semantic Web Applications
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing quality ontologies (DQV, DaQ) do not support per-observation quality; the IDQA vocabulary was added to complement ssn-system:MeasurementRange.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantics in Sensor Networks: An Ontology for Dynamic Transfer Behavior in Calibrated Sensors
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA lack a description of dynamic transfer models and uncertainty; the authors extend them with the trans ontology; quality of data is future work

gaps_about_sosa.title: Existing Semantic Ontology and its Challenges for Enhancing Interoperability in IoT Environment
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN has restricted concepts for sensor data relationships; no existing ontology is comprehensive, so a multi-domain common core IoT ontology is needed

gaps_about_sosa.title: Enabling privacy-aware interoperable and quality IoT data sharing with context
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SOSA gap reported; the work's small ontology lacks context such as location, and context-dependent variability of concepts limits interoperability.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Enhancing energy management at district and building levels via an EM-KPI ontology
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks time and unit domains, imported from OWL-Time and OM; dependency on the version of reused ontologies (high impact on the observation module)

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Description of Data Mining Datasets: An Ontology-Based Annotation Schema
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No general EO ontology exists; SSN/SOSA and other ontologies cover only parts of the domain, so a lightweight EO ontology aligned with them was built.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ontology-grounded cooperative perception in IoMT: from evidence to maintained event knowledge.
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing SSN-based hazard ontologies do not represent observation quality or reliability, and the pre-detection evidence stage is not distinguished.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Evolving Ontology for Vehicle Signals
gaps_about_sosa.gap: VSS has no sensor concept, so mapping VSS branches to SOSA sensors and actuators is inconsistent; a sensor concept would need a separate extension.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Abnormal Situations Interpretation in Industry 4.0 using Stream Reasoning
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Reasoning over SSN-based ontologies is limited to static data and does not suit dynamic industrial streams; the work answers with stream reasoning.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantically Enhanced Time Series Databases in IoT-Edge-Cloud Infrastructure
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN System concept does not capture entity correlations or support deriving higher-level properties; no support for deriving one metric from others

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ontology-Based Integration of Vehicle-Related Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/VSSo model individual observations only: no time windows, aggregations or events for high-frequency streams; CTDO assumes synchronized sensors

gaps_about_sosa.title: The template for a Semantic SensorThings API with the GloSIS use case
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Tooling gaps in glrc for STA (pagination); SOSA v2 expected to add sampling and OMS alignment; automated STA generation from SOSA knowledge graphs.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Quality of Observation within Sensor Web systems : from theory to practice
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN-XG misaligned with OGC Observation and too heavyweight; difficulty describing capabilities of virtual sensors (e.g. API call limits, frequency)

gaps_about_sosa.title: OneForestKB: A Knowledge Base for Global Forest Data Curation and Exploitation Using Geospatial Services
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Redundant attributes across observations (unit, observed property, result time) factorised with observation collections; no criticism of SOSA/SSN.

gaps_about_sosa.title: A system for publishing sensor data on the Semantic Web
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Application-specific platform class (LightPole) and sensor device types added as subclasses; location handled with WGS84/GeoNames rather than SSN.

gaps_about_sosa.title: PROVIDING FAIR AND METROLOGICALLY TRACEABLE DATA SETS - A CASE STUDY
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No single vocabulary covers the needs; SOSA is used only for the sensor link, while units come from D-SI and quantities and uncertainty from QUDT.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Towards Developing an Ontology for a Digital Twin in Battery Testing
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing digital twin ontologies do not cover battery testing; a hybrid of SSN/SOSA with battery-specific constructs is proposed but not realised.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Rule-Based Model for Smart Building Supervision and Management
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing ontologies, SSN included, cover only a subset of the smart BMS domains (energy, security, facility, ICT) and do not suit critical sites.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Automating IoT Data-Intensive Application Allocation in Clustered Edge Computing
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN lack concepts for computing task requirements and functional/non-functional (big data V-metrics) device properties; extended accordingly

gaps_about_sosa.title: Context-aware Reactive Systems based on Runtime Semantic Models (S)
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN lacks machine-actionable software procedures and mechanisms linking observations to actuations for reactive systems; an extension is proposed

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Interoperability Middleware for IIoT
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing IIoT ontologies do not describe the type and structure of shared data, communication devices or protocols; no SSN-specific gap is stated

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic modelling of Earth Observation remote sensing
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing ontologies (including SSN) lack remote-sensing-specific elements such as spectral bands, indices and product meta-data; RESEO adds them.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Deploying spatial-stream query answering in C-ITS scenarios1
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Experts: LDM ontology lacked sensor/observation concepts; suggested alignment with SSN (Stimulus, Sensor, Observation); uncertainty not captured

gaps_about_sosa.title: MIFE and MIFD: Minimum information for fermentation experiments and devices
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN are dedicated to sensors and do not cover fermentation experiment concepts such as hierarchical devices, vessels and observation units

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Architecture for Modelling and Reasoning IoT Data Resources based on SPARK
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN has limitations for temporal and spatial information of sensor resources, and represents IoT devices only partially (only sensing devices).

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantic Technologies for Vehicle Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA lacks an event interaction pattern; no single unit ontology; quality, reliability, frequency and provenance modelling left as future work

gaps_about_sosa.title: Multi-ontology mapping generative adversarial network in internet of things for ontology alignment
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN is judged limited in scope (only sensors and actuators); no universal reference IoT ontology exists, so fragmentation motivates alignment.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SOSA: A Lightweight Ontology for Sensors, Observations, Samples, and Actuators
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No collection classes in SOSA/SSN; no geometry; custom datatypes are not supported by RDF/SPARQL engines; actuator interfaces are out of scope

gaps_about_sosa.title: Towards Globally Unique Identification of Physical Samples: Governance and Technical Implementation of the IGSN Global Sample Number
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Planned semantic alignment of the IGSN metadata schema with SOSA/SSN; the current metadata schemas struggle to accommodate other disciplines.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Lemons: Leveraging Model-Based Techniques to Enable Non-Intrusive Semantic Enrichment in Wireless Sensor Networks
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Mapping SSN to Ecore is hard because of differing expressiveness (e.g. multiple classification); QUDT lacks vector types for sensor attitude.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ein Metadatenlabel für das semantische Sensorweb
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Facet semantics do not match SSN information sources exactly; no full DUV alignment with SOSA; XPath on RDF/XML is complex, SPARQL suggested

gaps_about_sosa.title: Ontology-Driven Semantic Configuration and Prioritization of Earth Observation Opportunities for Sustainable Urban Disaster Response
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN/SOSA gives general sensor semantics but lacks disaster-oriented resource qualification and links to context and vulnerable urban objects

gaps_about_sosa.title: SEMIoTICS: Semantically Enhanced IoT-Enabled Intelligent Control Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Semantic models such as SSN lack explicit modelling of control and processing components; the work extends them by combining SSN with OWL-S.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Expert-Validated Bridging Model for IoT Process Mining
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA has few attributes and focuses on data generation, with little attention to devices and platforms; it lacks event and process concepts.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantics-Driven Programming of Self-Adaptive Reactive Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN cannot describe executable procedure logic or machine-actionable behaviours; the LSA extension (software procedures, states) is proposed

gaps_about_sosa.title: Context-Based Knowledge Discovery and Querying for Social Media Data
gaps_about_sosa.gap: Existing SSN-based hazard ontologies cannot represent human sensors (social media data); further processing is needed for multi-hazard EWS.

gaps_about_sosa.title: An Automated Metadata Generation Method for Data Lake of Industrial WoT Applications
gaps_about_sosa.gap: No SSN-specific gap; notes that automated mapping and annotation of industrial data with existing ontologies (SSN, WoT TD) remain unsolved.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Semantically Enhanced Time Series Databases in IoT-Edge-Cloud Infrastructure
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN System concept lacks entity correlations and cannot support deriving properties of higher-level entities; no metric derivation support

gaps_about_sosa.title: Challenges and Opportunities in Applying Semantics to Improve Access Control in the Field of Internet of Things
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SSN does not model measurement units or the domain/context knowledge of devices; it requires integration with domain ontologies for these.

gaps_about_sosa.title: SIMON: A Domain-Agnostic Framework for Secure Design and Validation of Cyber Physical Systems
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA does not cover processing and communication subsystems, so it must be extended for security reasoning; it defines no unit ontology.

gaps_about_sosa.title: Abstracting Interactions with IoT Devices Towards a Semantic Vision of Smart Spaces
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA/SSN lacks high-level entity concepts, static properties, and a link between property types and observation types; extended by semic

gaps_about_sosa.title: Process Mining Workshops
gaps_about_sosa.gap: SOSA and IoTStream are event-centric and give little attention to devices and platforms; no event or context concepts for process mining

gaps_about_sosa.title: A Digital Twins Platform for Digital Manufacturing
